limitations: This reviews the current authored guided bank and preview, not every question in PDF-only library papers. New guided papers must pass the standing authoring and audit gates.
Five groups have two defensible follow-ups because a third sufficiently close match was absent.
Some matches practise specific prerequisites; their relationship is recorded as transfer rather than direct.
Content coverage and guided success are not evidence of a guaranteed examination score.
preservation: Frozen original papers, saved accounts, answers, numbered attempts and scores remain unchanged. New attempts receive the reviewed teaching edition.
